 The Golden Disc Awards, coming to Vietnam for the first time, will break all records; which superstars will be featured remains a secret.
 The 41st Golden Disc Awards not only projected an attendance of 70,000 people over two nights in person, but also aimed to break all records for online viewership across digital platforms compared to the previous 40 editions.
 Báo Tuổi Trẻ • 11/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Overview of the signing ceremony for the Vietnam - More Than Just an Experience program - Photo: DAU DUNG
 On the afternoon of November 11th, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and its partners signed and announced the Vietnam - Experience More program for the period 2027-2031, aiming to select and collaborate on bringing internationally attractive cultural , artistic , sports , and entertainment events to Vietnam.
 The 41st Golden Disc Awards ceremony, scheduled to be held in Hanoi on January 9th and 10th, 2027, will be the opening salvo.
 Golden Disc Awards " promotes Hanoi as ​ " The new center of the Asian music festival " ​ ​ 
 Mr. Kim Yooseok, General Manager of HLL JoongAng, the company managing the rights to the Golden Disc Awards, shared that the Golden Disc Awards has been a companion to the development of Korean popular music and the globalization of K-pop for over 40 years.
 This is the first time this awards ceremony has been held in Vietnam, bringing together prominent Korean artists, creating a vibrant red carpet atmosphere, and featuring special stage performances unique to the Golden Disc Awards.
 The awards ceremony was also broadcast live in South Korea and many countries around the world , conveying the full atmosphere of Hanoi to fans worldwide. 
 Deputy Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Nguyen Huy Dung delivers a speech - Photo: DAU DUNG
 According to him, Vietnam is one of the countries with the most enthusiastic support for K-pop; Korean music, films, television shows, and cuisine have blended into the daily lives of Vietnamese people, bringing the cultural gap between the two countries closer than ever before.
 "The organizers expect this awards ceremony to promote Hanoi as a new hub for Asian music festivals, while also creating a starting point for growth and cooperation between the Korean and Vietnamese entertainment industries," he said.
 You may also like It's not just about bringing an event to Vietnam.
 Deputy Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Nguyen Huy Dung stated, "Vietnam warmly welcomes and will create the most favorable mechanisms, policies, and environment for international friends to visit Vietnam."
 Conversely, Vietnam will also strive to bring its cultural values, sporting achievements, and the beauty of its heritage and tourism to the world. 
 Mr. Kim Yooseok, representative of the Golden Disc Awards copyright management unit, shared this information. (Photo: DAU DUNG)
 A representative from the ministry also added that the 41st Golden Disc Awards not only expects to attract 70,000 in-person attendees, but also aims to break all records for global online viewership across digital platforms compared to previous editions.
 The event also aims to introduce Hanoi and Vietnam's "signature tours" (high-quality, distinctive tours) to international friends, hoping to become a center for attracting the participation of artists, businesses, and the domestic cultural and tourism industry ecosystem. 
 The 41st Golden Disc Awards will be hosted by singer Sung Si Kyung (right) and actress Moon Ga Young - Photo: K-Biz
 According to Mr. Pham Nhu Anh, the representative of the organizing committee in Vietnam, that is also the goal of the Vietnam - Experience More cooperation program, which is not just to bring an event to Vietnam.
 "We hope that the appeal of each event will create more reasons for tourists to come to Vietnam, stay longer, experience more, spend more, and want to return," he said. 
 "Which star will be coming is still a lovely secret."
 The Golden Disc Awards is one of South Korea's oldest and most prestigious music awards ceremonies, held since 1986 and having a significant influence on the K-pop industry.
 You may also like After several editions held in major cities such as Tokyo (Japan), Taipei (China), Hong Kong (China)... in the Asian region, The 41st Golden Disc Awards is being held in Vietnam for the first time. 
 Jennie (BLACKPINK) won Artist of the Year at the 2025 Golden Disc Awards - Photo: Golden Disc Awards
 Previous Golden Disc Awards have brought together many notable K-pop stars such as Jennie (BlackPink), Cortis, Stray Kids, IVE, Le Sserafim, NCT Wish, Monsta X, Byeon Woo Seok… along with many famous artists and actors including Hsu Guang Han who performed and presented awards.
 The 40th Golden Disc Awards ceremony in Taipei attracted 290 million global viewers, nearly 50 million votes, and almost 80,000 live attendees at the Taipei Dome, with nearly 50% of the ticketed attendees being international visitors.
 Which international stars and famous Vietnamese artists will appear at The 41st Golden Disc Awards? Mr. Pham Nhu Anh told Tuoi Tre newspaper , "This will still be a very lovely secret," and the organizers will gradually announce the information on the program's official fanpage.
